entries.requiredScope: Prove exact one-to-one, visibility-compatible classification of the authoritative union of the Level-0 home-baseline self record resolved from the executing repository and configured origin plus every active kind=git-repository fleet-manifest target; prove the current 1 + 47 = 48 result, exclusion of spec-kit-preset-projects and all collection nodes, the three required Public Canaries, live cardinality recomputation, and fail-closed missing, unknown, duplicate, and incompatible fixtures.
entries.rationale: AC-CBG-001 is a binding Stage A acceptance criterion and requires executable positive and negative classification evidence.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Profile names, visibility rules, fleet manifest schema, stable repository IDs, or live inventory adapter change.

entries.requiredScope: Prove that Private Governance/Scaffold plans zero full private PR/main builds, no more than one lean path-aware PR gate, and retains separate local-evidence and server-side PR/status boundaries.
entries.rationale: The local hook is not a complete security boundary; the canonical server-gate simulation is mandatory.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Private governance triggers, minimal-gate definition, branch protection model, or hook/server trust boundary changes.

entries.requiredScope: Prove that a simulated change across all six SecureCaseTracker language repositories produces no more than six distinct path-appropriate product PR jobs.
entries.rationale: The six-product cap is a measurable acceptance boundary for path-contract deduplication.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: CaseTracker language repository count, product path contracts, or job deduplication semantics change.

entries.requiredScope: Prove the Decimal-based Stage A cost projection reports approximately 22 recurring private jobs per week, separates demand minimal gates, and explains every deviation.
entries.rationale: Recurring load and demand-driven gates must remain independently auditable.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Schedules, live cardinalities, duration inputs, weeks-per-month factor, or budget categories change.

entries.requiredScope: Prove planned private Actions usage is below 500 of 3000 minutes per month and excludes Copilot AI credits and Copilot review runner time from that value.
entries.rationale: The monthly target is binding and must not be made green by category mixing or missing-data-as-zero behavior.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Private Actions budget, target threshold, billing assumptions, or Copilot consumption model changes.

entries.requiredScope: Prove repeated zero-, single-, and multi-repository fixtures have identical normalized ordered decisions, hashes, and exit codes; timestamp variation must not affect decision or gate-set binding.
entries.rationale: The macOS Primary aggregator validates deterministic fixtures for semantic macOS, Linux, and Windows normalization; its hash-bound internal input files are not autonomous gate-evidence rows.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Canonical JSON, ordering, hash inputs, clock handling, platform normalization, or exit-code contract changes.

entries.requiredScope: Prove all missing, stale, failed, mismatched-HEAD, mismatched-gate-set, and stale-hook evidence fixtures block; matching evidence passes locally; workflow/ruleset fixtures block unchecked default-branch writes when the hook is absent or bypassed.
entries.rationale: Defense in depth requires both local evidence validation and an independent server-contract proof.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Evidence schema/path, hook versioning, default-branch protection, required status, or bypass model changes.

entries.requiredScope: The Primary aggregator must orchestrate Bash syntax, PowerShell and PSScriptAnalyzer, parity fixtures, existing maintenance regression safety, secret scanning, A11Y, documentation, workflow/path-contract, and statistics checks. It must validate one manual target-OS run per Bash and PowerShell variant; macOS supplies both current manual records, while fixtures prove semantic macOS, Linux, and Windows normalization without claiming unexecuted runners.
entries.rationale: The feature changes a critical paired script surface and user-facing text, so full platform, accessibility, security, and regression evidence is mandatory.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Supported platform, wrapper surface, validator inventory, user-facing output, documentation, or statistics contract changes.

entries.requiredScope: The Primary aggregator must run the mutation spy and validate the exact Stage A Git-diff allowlist, proving zero Copilot reviewer, G4, GitHub account, active ruleset, target-repository, commit, push, merge, or Home-sync mutations and that G4 never starts.
entries.rationale: The LocalImplementation authority boundary is a delivery gate and cannot be inferred from intent alone.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Delivery authority, Stage A allowlist, GitHub adapter methods, Home Runtime scope, or G4 boundary changes.

entries.requiredScope: The Primary aggregator must validate fixture completeness plus the separately controlled read-only live inventory result. Prove every repository in the authoritative home-baseline plus active fleet-manifest Git-target union has one deterministic local rollout entry with profile, planned diff, gate decision, blockers, and remoteConverged=false; the collection is excluded, Stage A changes only Level-0 artifacts, and convergence is claimed for zero targets.
entries.rationale: Complete read-only fleet planning is the Stage A handoff deliverable and must not be confused with Stage B convergence.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Fleet membership, inventory source, rollout-entry schema, Level-0 ownership, or Stage B authority changes.
